correctness.rationale: In the \(\mathbb F_2^4\) coordinate model all 35 lines are enumerated via \(a\oplus b\). Exhaustive exact-cover branching yields precisely 56 five-line partitions, and an independent search over all 324632 five-line combinations yields the same. For each of 560 three-line deletions, exactly one other disjoint triple covers the same nine points. The 280 resulting undirected edges coincide with all spread pairs sharing two lines. Bron–Kerbosch on the complement exhaustively enumerates 23936 maximal independent sets, exactly eight with maximum cardinality 21. The 56 signatures use each of the eight families three times and are all distinct; all 1540 pairwise edges satisfy adjacency iff disjoint signatures. The proof explicitly establishes exhaustive recursion invariants and checker outputs. All 35 lines have distinct eight-spread incidence fingerprints, proving faithfulness of collineation action on spreads.

value.rationale: Regulus replacement is a geometrically natural local move on the classical smallest three-space, whose 56 spreads are already thoroughly catalogued. The exact switch graph is a familiar but highly structured Kneser graph, with intrinsic eight largest no-switch families, a sharp diameter-two exchange theorem, complete common-neighbor profile and index-two extra graph automorphisms. These connected results give more than a routine recount of known spreads or an arbitrary numerical slice; no general q theorem is claimed.
